steps.cap: Earlier stages make the chips. Before any of them can be sold, a machine tests each one, starting while the chips are still on the wafer.
Thousands of needles on a probe card press onto one chip. They touch small metal pads on its surface.
Through the needles, the tester sends signals into the chip and reads what comes back. It checks every answer.
The wafer moves under the needles, chip by chip. The tester marks any chip that answers wrong, and that chip goes no further.
Only chips that pass go on to be packaged. A modern accelerator bonds together a dozen expensive pieces, and one bad piece throws away all of them, so each piece is tested before it goes in.
